scenario: Two warm cached lyric projections during real 64 MiB ZIP compression
scope: One Linux native debug run with software-oriented Xvfb configuration. Delivery measurements include the renderer receipt acknowledgment. Visible-text measurements include configured transitions, DOM/CSS checks, RAF progress and the native STARTUP handshake. Neither is physical scanout/frame-time measurement. No Electron comparison or application-level speedup is established. Uncached show loading, startup, media/audio and hardware outputs are excluded.

environment.fonts: Noto Color Emoji 2.047 from Ubuntu package copied into isolated XDG profile

workload.generator: Python random.Random(20261018), 256 KiB random bytes hex-encoded and repeated 32 times per fixture
workload.zipVerified: entry lengths, CRCs and complete decompression

overlap: Exact backup job active before and after each paired acknowledgment; both output roles and library contexts asserted
quantiles: nearest rank over this single run; not a production tail-latency estimate
